## A word about British half hours

Great Britain settles in half-hourly periods, and tariffs like Octopus Agile
set a price for every 30 minutes. This forecast is hourly, because the
day-ahead auction it is built on is hourly. Picking GB in the setup dialog
now says so, once, before the entry is created.

The difference matters less than it sounds. Measured over 30 days of real
Agile prices, choosing when to charge by the hour rather than by the half
hour came out about 0.1 p/kWh worse - roughly six pence on a 40 kWh charge,
because the cheap hours tend to be cheap in both of their halves.

Where it does show is the price for *now*: an hourly average sits between
the two half-hourly rates you are billed, on average about 0.8 p from each.

## Updating from 1.16.0

Nothing to do. The note appears when a new entry is set up for GB, or when
an existing entry is moved to GB, and not again afterwards.
